description.en: FakeI2V-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating image-level and video-level deepfake detectors in video detection scenarios. It comprises 97,548 videos generated by recent generation models and covers multiple content categories, with detectors scored by AUC on detection tasks.

evidence.snippet: To fill this gap, we present FakeI2V-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating state-of-the-art video-level deepfake detectors in challenging scenarios, with a particular focus on systematically assessing the performance of image-level deepfake detectors in the video domain.

claire_radar.motivation: Recent advances in video generation models have significantly intensified the deepfake threat, yet the current deepfake video detection benchmarks remain underdeveloped.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing deepfake video benchmarks lack evaluation of image-level detectors' transferability to video, and this benchmark provides a large-scale, standardized protocol to measure detector performance across both detector types, aiding in model selection and development for practical deepfake video detection.
